plans.name: coursition-ui-integration
plans.overview: Integrate the three independent UI lanes, verify the combined application across themes and routes, correct only cross-lane defects, and publish the polished Cloudflare build.

todos.content: Review each lane against its ownership contract, reconcile the combined theme/shell/workflow result, and remove any accidental overlap or regressions.
Use TraceDecay to determine affected tests, run diagnostics and the relevant UltraModern, i18n, format, lint, type, and Cloudflare build checks, and fix integration defects.
Capture and inspect light/dark desktop and responsive screenshots for auth, dashboard, all seven course steps, and preview while checking URL, loading, locale, theme, and activity interactions.
Deploy the verified build to Cloudflare and perform a final production smoke check without changing AI provider configuration.

plans.name: coursition-ui-shell
plans.overview: Modernize the global Coursition shell, header, width, and theme-mode behavior while preserving URL-driven navigation and authentication semantics.

todos.content: Refine the sticky product header and main content measure so the shell feels lighter, calmer, and aligned with the new editorial workspace hierarchy.
Make the theme-toggle label and icon reflect the effective system/light/dark mode and preserve the existing cookie and pre-hydration behavior.
Verify locale links, sign-out, auth routes, sticky behavior, theme switching, and responsive header layout remain functional.

plans.name: coursition-ui-theme
plans.overview: Rebuild the Coursition visual foundation as a calm civic-editorial theme using UI-kit semantic and component tokens, with strong light/dark APCA contrast and far less border-driven hierarchy.

todos.content: Replace the current neutral card-heavy theme values with a coherent civic-editorial palette, surface ladder, typography, radii, depth, and focus language in coursition-theme.css.
Tune buttons, form controls, tabs, accordions, radio cards, steps, badges, and feedback surfaces through supported UI-kit component tokens without page-specific selectors.
Verify representative light and dark states preserve high APCA contrast and usable focus, disabled, hover, selected, and destructive states.

plans.name: coursition-ui-workflow
plans.overview: Flatten and polish the authentication, dashboard, course studio, editor, and learner-preview composition using the existing UI-kit components and a small shared semantic class vocabulary.

todos.content: Replace the universal bordered card treatment with distinct shared studio-header, workspace-section, and inset surface roles that avoid nested boxes.
Refine authentication, dashboard, mode selection, and source management into calmer editorial compositions with one clear primary action per screen.
Refine preparation, objective, and activity-plan screens with constrained reading measure, borderless list hierarchy, compact metadata, and clearer generation actions.
Flatten course content and playable preview surfaces so learner content, activities, self-checks, feedback, and review states have clear hierarchy without nested card stacks.
Verify all seven course steps, dashboard actions, activity engines, responsive wrapping, and keyboard semantics remain behaviorally unchanged.
